title: P0 Repair Discovery: Atomic Commit Boundary & Durable Idempotency

blockersAnalyzed.title: Absence of Atomic Transaction Boundary across Multi-Entity Domain Writes
blockersAnalyzed.findings: Existing writes occur in sequential async loop. Firestore runTransaction/writeBatch is needed to provide all-or-nothing atomicity across trips, drivers, trucks, roster, and batch state.

blockersAnalyzed.title: In-Memory Commit Record & Idempotency Storage
blockersAnalyzed.findings: Commit records and replay history are held in-memory. Durable storage in existing projects/{projectId}/import_batches and projects/{projectId}/sync_operations collections provides multi-instance and restart safety with 0 schema changes.

repairArchitecture.atomicBoundary: Firestore runTransaction wrapping session state check, domain writes, and commit record creation
repairArchitecture.concurrencyMechanism: Atomic read-and-check inside runTransaction on the import session / batch document
